candidate_i.i_Y_identity: Y = f + X on the wall (X = (xi.n)^2 = adot^2) [D]
candidate_i.i_M_for_drag: M = rho_b/(3*X + 4*f) ~ rho_b/(4 k^2 r^2) reproduces Delta Sigma = rho_b adot^2/2 [D]
candidate_i.i_frame: The dust's 4-velocity is u_xi = xi_par/sqrt(Y), fixed by geometry: it is locked to the bulk static frame, not free-falling. In the bulk-rest flux frame that is F_d = 0: Law C (criterion 5). [D]
candidate_i.i_detuning: F = f + delta adds d(rho)/d(delta) = rho_b*(-X - 2*f)/(3*X + 4*f) at delta -> 0 (an anti-gravitating dust term independent of adot). Keeping it below the drag rho_b X/2 needs |delta|/f < X/f ~ (H/k)^2 [D].
candidate_i.i_covariant_variation: d(Y + xi.xi)/d g_AB = X n^A n^B to 5.5e-10 (numerical, generic wall point): purely normal-normal [D]
candidate_i.i_energy: Criteria 2 and 4: with Delta Sigma = rho_b adot^2/2 by construction and w_d ~ 0, the wall energy equation gives Q4 = Delta Sigma' + 3H Delta Sigma = 2H Delta Sigma (3/2 - q) >= 2H Delta Sigma > 0 on z in [0, 10] (fitted q in [-0.41, 0.50], candidate_iii q_range). The exchange partner is the bulk scalar phi whose profile carries the coupling functions F(phi), M(phi) (explicit phi-dependence plus the mixed normal-tangential source). [D]
candidate_i.i_verdict: (i) passes criteria 1, 2, 4 and gives Law C (criterion 5), but fails criterion 3: the O(k^2 a^2) term cancels only if the coupling's stationary point F equals f to relative precision (H/k)^2 (~1e-61 for micron AdS). Enforcing F = -xi.xi covariantly removes the tangential dust (the variation is purely normal-normal), reducing to candidate (a), w = -1. Ghost/gradient stability: not tested. [D]/[X] as a natural mechanism

candidate_iii.iii_sign: Q = C rho_med v^3 >= 0 at every epoch: single-sign inflow (criterion 2: pass) [D]
candidate_iii.iii_required_profile: closing Delta Sigma' + 3H Delta Sigma = Q with Delta Sigma ~ a^2 H^2 needs rho_med(r) ~ r^2 (3/2 - q(r)) on the wall's path; (3/2 - q) runs 1.00-1.91 on z in [0, 10]; best power law r^2.22 misses by up to 19%: the medium's radial profile must encode the fitted expansion history [D]
candidate_iii.iii_heat_channel: Criterion 1 depends on what absorbs the dissipated energy: wall radiation (w = 1/3) is the conformal case, which cancels the drag exactly (FLUX_CODAZZI kappa = 0); massive wall dust (w = 0) keeps it. Not fixed by friction itself.
candidate_iii.iii_backreaction: rho_med/|rho_Lambda5| ~ 2 x0 (Delta k/k) ~ 4.6 Delta k/k at x0 = 2.24: perturbative only for Delta k/k << 0.2 (brainstorm arithmetic, re-derived)
candidate_iii.iii_momentum_law: tangential friction against a medium at rest in the static frame pins wall matter toward that frame: a Law-B relaxation with rate set by the same coupling [O]
candidate_iii.iii_verdict: (iii) passes criterion 2, meets criterion 4 only with a radial profile tuned to the fitted q(z), and leaves criterion 1 to the unspecified heat channel; criterion 6 not tested. A different model needing its own refit, not a closure [O].

candidate_ii: Radial string-forest pinning: not tested (no concrete action specified).
verdict: None of the tested candidates is a natural covariant source of the w_d = 0 drag. (i) gives Law C only with an (H/k)^2 tuning, and its covariant form collapses to the w = -1 tension already excluded; (iii) needs a profile tuned to the expansion history and an unspecified heat channel. (ii) untested.
